visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Enable a Button When Ready
visualizerParams.description: Type a form where the Send button is disabled until something is typed. The input event runs on every key, and the disabled property turns the button on and off.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<input id="msg" placeholder="Message">
<button id="send" disabled>Send</button>
<script>
  var msg = document.getElementById('msg');
  var send = document.getElementById('send');
  msg.addEventListener('input', function () {
    send.disabled = msg.value.trim() === '';
  });
</script>

checks.label: Clearing the message disables it again
